name: Notional V1 Escrow uint128 truncation in free-collateral ETH conversion
summary: Notional V1 Escrow.convertBalancesToETH (ExchangeRate._convertToETH) casts abs(balance) to uint128 without a bound check, so a net currency balance of -2^128 converts to 0 ETH. Via public ERC1155Trade.safeTransferFrom fCash pair mints the attacker made one account owe exactly 2^128 DAI fCash while passing the free-collateral check, used the unbacked 2^128-1 receiver leg as collateral to mint matured DAI/USDC claims sized to the escrow balances, then settled and withdrew all DAI and USDC from the escrow.

loss.notes: Exact escrow depletion in source-3: the Escrow proxy's entire DAI and USDC balances. The attacker supplied no tokens (source-1 moves no ERC-20). WETH and WBTC held by the escrow were not taken by the attacker. A third-party liquidation at block 25900571 is excluded (liquidator paid USDC for WETH collateral).

ageReset.description: The first of two Upgraded events on the Escrow proxy selected Escrow implementation 0x8a134e65, which inlines the truncating ExchangeRate._convertToETH; the second (block 25901449, the post-incident fix) follows the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 25900220, tx 0, attacker EOA 0xdacc235a creates exploit contract 0xec434a2f): the constructor creates four helpers and calls ERC1155Trade proxy 0xbba89957 (impl 0x6f102516) safeTransferFrom(selector 0xf242432a) with asset type byte 0xa8 (CASH_RECEIVER), so payer=from: (1) id 0x200006a9a0a00a8 (cash group 2 = currency 1 DAI, maturity 1788480000) value 1 to 0x5872b67d; (2) id 0x200006b10b100a8 value 2^128-1 to 0x84a060ed. Portfolios proxy 0x0a472111 (impl 0xfce1c68e).mintfCashPair checks freeCollateral(payer), which STATICCALLs Escrow proxy 0x9abd0b88 convertBalancesToETH (0x215b92fe, delegatecall to impl 0x8a134e65): after leg (2) input [0,-340282366920938463463374607431768211456,0,0] returns [0,0,0,0], so fc=0 passes. Cause (source-5): ExchangeRate._convertToETH does uint128 absBalance = uint128(balance.abs()); 2^128 truncates to 0. Reproduce: eth_call Escrow proxy convertBalancesToETH([0,-2^128,0,0]) at block 25900219 returns [0,0,0,0]; with -(2^128-1) it returns [0,-190480797877231089539167114479984666,0,0]. 0x84a060ed then mints DAI receiver 69257372677950923155658 to 0x265ccff3 and USDC receiver (cash group 3) 1658524864122 to 0x4a3508c5, collateralized by its unbacked 2^128-1 receiver leg (convert input [0,298329352496312526619766614701929338342,-1658524864122,0]). Source-3 (block 25900234, tx 8) settles those claims after maturity and withdraws. The ERC-1155 pair mint and Portfolios summation are designed behavior bounded per call to 2^128-1; the invariant break is the unchecked truncation compiled only into the Escrow implementation, so Escrow is the single target. First exercise: eth_getLogs on ERC1155Trade proxy blocks 11008006..25900220 returns 4 TransferSingle (0xc3d58168...) logs, all in source-1 (safeTransferFrom emits it on every success; safeBatchTransferFrom reverts); cash-market trades and deposits cannot reach a 2^128 balance. Age: eth_getCode of 0x8a134e65 empty at 11396622, keccak 0x5ab55c8b...2e28 at 11396623 (creation 0x74999c5ba6958d25e3f5b9c4efe31dc63bbaf98fd6963e786ce692541a873a44), 11405308 and 25900219. Proxy code keccak 0x7961ba00...c81f at 11007909 and 25900219, empty at 11007908; CREATE2 by factory 0xc981d9e5 in the deployment tx per callTracer. EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a1...2bbc: 0xd890154a at 11007909..11405307, 0x8a134e65 at 11405308..25901448, 0x7885484e at 25901449. eth_getLogs Upgraded (0xbc7cd75a) on the proxy from 11007909 to latest returns two: source-9 (block 11405308, tx 217, log 389, Safe 0x22341fb5 execTransaction via ProxyAdmin 0x09dba4fa) and the post-incident fix 0x012fc554b165b3b3ccf3121018ae26503cab50031fa84adea29253b1cd5831d9 (block 25901449). Configuration review (source-10) finds no value necessary to the truncation after 11405308.

Verified source for Escrow impl 0x8a134e651432a902041643668940c9a9cd270633 (Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=1): standard-JSON of 47 files, v0.6.4+commit.1dca32f3, optimizer 200 runs; SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode string cef547505a13d60c8fe89e5c825a98bb80982e165771fd7a7996cf11edec658b. Same source set is verified for Portfolios impl 0xfce1c68e and ERC1155Trade impl 0x6f102516. Inspect utils/ExchangeRate.sol _convertToETH (uint128(balance.abs()) cast), Escrow.convertBalancesToETH, Portfolios._freeCollateral and mintfCashPair (free-collateral check on the payer only), ERC1155Trade.safeTransferFrom (value <= MAX_UINT_128, pair mint).

Reviewed gross loss. eth_getTransactionReceipt of source-3: log 0x23 DAI Transfer Escrow proxy 0x9abd0b88 -> 0x265ccff3 of 69257372677950923155658; log 0x27 USDC Transfer Escrow -> 0x4a3508c5 of 1658524864122; logs 0x25/0x29 forward both to attacker EOA 0xdacc235a. balanceOf(Escrow) at block 25900233: DAI 69257372677950923155658, USDC 1658524864122; at 25900234 both 0, so the escrow's entire balances were taken. Source-1 has no ERC-20 Transfer logs (attacker input zero). Etherscan tokentx for the escrow from block 25890000 shows no other attacker outflow before the fix at block 25901449; escrow WETH (23.897838291461241816 at 25900219) and WBTC (0.00499717) were not taken by the attacker. Tx 0x6c7ca03df356282bdce23788103f8950d788dd0c5c2491ad9f31b3e3e679bcef (block 25900571) is a third-party LiquidateBatch (event 0xd54ff80d) where the liquidator deposits USDC for WETH, as in earlier liquidation 0xf16a994f48bcbf103b3860b5141dc997f0ec19825526890181bd2f703fcd8a79; not exploit loss. Attacker funds later moved via 0x8aaf01b6 and 0xc95496c9 to Tornado Cash router 0xd90e2f92.

Configuration review. eth_getLogs on Escrow proxy blocks 11007909..25900219, excluding Deposit/Withdraw/Liquidate: NewCurrency WETH 11007909, DAI 11008237, USDC 11492295, WBTC 11576597; UpdateExchangeRate(1,0) 11008242 and 11656218, (2,0) 11492517, (3,0) 11576599; SetDiscounts 11008076, 11396441, 12161168; OwnershipTransferred to Safe 0x22341fb5 11008373; Upgraded 11405308; LiquidateBatch 25541217. Portfolios proxy: SetMaxAssets 11007972; SetHaircuts 11008079, 11498089; NewCashGroup 1 11008258, 2 11008284, 3 11493061; UpdateCashGroup(1) 11562247; OwnershipTransferred 11008377; Upgraded to 0xfce1c68e at 11405324 (sole). ERC1155Trade proxy: Upgraded 11185699 and 11405295 (to 0x6f102516), OwnershipTransferred, ApprovalForAll, BatchOperation only. The truncation zeroes any -2^128 balance independent of oracle rate, buffer, discounts or haircuts, and it was exercised in DAI (currency 1, cash group 2, both configured before 11405308); the later USDC listing and cash group 3 only widened exposure. No post-activation configuration value is necessary to the vulnerable condition.
